British Columbia

7 directory entries · Research in progress

  • Babine↗historical and present
    Connection & source
    historical and present

    Dateline and quick facts explicitly place Lake Babine Nation and traditional territory in British Columbia. Does not equate all Babine communities with this single government.

    Traditional territory and communities described in February 2024. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Chilcotin (Tŝilhqot'in)↗Continuing government and community location
    Connection & source
    Continuing government and community location

    Actual government passage identifies Tŝilhqot’in people living at Williams Lake and office in British Columbia. Office is on Secwépemc territory; not a claim that office site is Tŝilhqot’in ancestral land.

    Historical and continuing; selected geography inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Comox↗Historical and continuing community connection
    Connection & source
    Historical and continuing community connection

    Actual K’ómoks community cultural history identifies Comox-area communities and British Columbia context; K’ómoks and Pentlatch identities are not interchangeable.

    Historical and continuing; geography passage inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Gitxsan↗Historical and continuing homeland connection
    Connection & source
    Historical and continuing homeland connection

    Actual Huwilp government About identifies Northwest British Columbia lands from Terrace to Hazelton to Smithers; independent Houses retain distinctions.

    Historical and continuing; geography passage inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

  • Heiltsuk↗Historical and continuing homeland connection
    Connection & source
    Historical and continuing homeland connection

    Actual Nation introduction explicitly identifies Central Coast British Columbia; general regional link only.

  • Lillooet (St'át'imc)↗Present community service location
    Connection & source
    Present community service location

    St'át'imc Government Services describes the St'át'imc people and publishes its office location as Lillooet, BC. The directory's Lillooet alias connects here; an office location does not define the nation's territory.

    Public content inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Nuxalk↗Community published homeland connection
    Connection & source
    Community published homeland connection

    The community-published opening identifies Nuxalk Territory, also called the Bella Coola Valley, on British Columbia's central coast. Undated account; no population figure or precise boundary is adopted.

    Public content inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗

These are starting lists, not a complete census. Modern borders help you navigate; they are not Indigenous homeland boundaries. A connection may be historical or present-day and does not imply presence throughout a region. Directory names can overlap; the profiles explain their relationships.
